svg.text: Header red #DB2031 from the current app, shown at 1.5x real size

g.text: White M with black badge. At 28dp the badge is a dot and the S disappears.
The full-colour mark on a white tile. Same logo as everywhere else, best contrast, S stays readable.
All white, S cut out of the badge so the red shows through. Cleanest, but the S is small.
C · M only at small sizes
Header cut: heavy white M, no badge. Keep the badge for 48dp and larger.
Tile plus the wordmark in the header, no logo on the right. Screen title moves to the right.
White header with the colour mark, red stays on the bottom bar. Biggest change.
